p: Kirkgate runs south from the cathedral towards the River Calder, so you're on one of the city's oldest streets here. Keep walking down the hill and you'll reach the Hepworth Wakefield, the free gallery by the river with Barbara Hepworth's sculptures, and nearby the medieval Chantry Chapel built on the old bridge over the Calder.
Kirkgate station is at the bottom of the street and Westgate station, on the main line to London, is a short walk across the centre. Trinity Walk shopping centre is just to the north.
Out of town, the Yorkshire Sculpture Park is a short drive away and is free to visit, with parking charges.
